decision.reason: [ev-2172e85c5351] is a single changelog line saying `flux push artifact` was fixed for insecure registries. It does not say what failed before, what the fix changes, or whether existing invocations now behave differently (for example, whether a flag is now required). So the proposed "none" and its claim that the command "previously failed" are not supported by the evidence, but a failure kind or behavior-change isn't supported either. The description or diff of PR #5449 is needed to tell what an exposed environment that does nothing will see.
